# Decimate

Reduces splat count by keeping larger, more opaque splats within your selection.

`lfs.decimate` · Clean-up

## How to use

Start with Keep Fraction 0.5 to retain about half the selected splats.\
Unselected splats always stay; tied scores can keep more than requested.

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geometry | `Geometry` | lfs.geometry | — | — | Geometry you want to edit. Connect a source; an unconnected input supplies no geometry. |
| Selection | `Selection` | lfs.float | 1 | min 0; max 1; step 0.01; accepts per-element values | Which splats you reduce: weights of 0.5 or more. Unconnected includes every splat. |
| Keep Fraction | `Keep Fraction` | lfs.float | 0.5 | min 0.001; max 1; step 0.001 | Share of selected splats to keep, 0.001–1. 0.5 keeps about half; 1 keeps all. |

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geometry | `Geometry` | lfs.geometry | — | — | Resulting geometry. Connect to another editing node or Group Output. |
